answer: A Phone SIM bound by one-time code delivery with a ninety-day rotation cooldown turns a private channel into public evidence: the phone sim answers a fresh challenge, the one-time code delivery is recorded, and a ninety-day rotation cooldown keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so anyone can check that the identity is backed by a real, reachable channel. Without this check, a ripple of borrowed channels could flood the network overnight. Whether the proof comes from a shale or a falcon, the verification step is identical and public.
